I farm here in Tigray, and this small plot of millet is only a small piece of my land. Millet does not demand much fertilizer like teff or wheat, but I learned in school that a little DAP at planting helps the crop stand strong, so I will put some — just what I can afford from the cooperative. I also have manure from our animals, which I will spread before plowing. For seed I will use my own saved millet seed like my neighbors — the improved varieties are not really sold for millet here, and on a rented small plot I will not take that risk. I will weed twice with my family and do not need to hire people for such a small plot.
